subject: KelpTech discovery recap & kickoff ownership
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ethan Gallagher <ethan@kelptech.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 2 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: KelpTech discovery recap & proposed kickoff

Hi Ethan —

Great to meet earlier today. Quick recap from our discovery and a suggested path to get the trial rolling: 

- Pain: KelpTech needs predictable low-latency embedding and chat routing for search assistant (20M monthly queries, mixed short/long prompts).
- Goal: Validate end-to-end latency and cost under a 2-week pilot (sandbox data, redaction on ingestion).
- Success metrics: p50 latency < 250ms, cost per 1k tokens under target after batching.

Suggested next steps (want to own these if you’re happy):
1) Kickoff + environment checklist (30–45 min) — propose Tue 2027-05-04 or Wed 2027-05-05; calendar link below.
2) We’ll provision a trial instance and share a short onboarding runbook.
3) Run a quick smoke test with a small dataset (we provide a test harness).

I attached a 1-page kickoff-checklist to speed setup. If procurement needs a statement of work or an internal contact, loop them in and I’ll coordinate.

Calendar: https://cal.com/kimberly-redwood/kelptech-kickoff
Attachment: kickoff-checklist.pdf (PDF, 84KB)

Thanks — I’ll hold Tue/Wed open until I hear back.

—Kimberly Park
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

Kim —

Thanks for the concise summary. I recommend the following, given signal and low risk:

1) Offer a one-time 2-week extension to the trial and schedule a dedicated onboarding slot (we’ll commit an SE for the first session).
2) Do not provision reserved capacity yet — give sandbox access only.
3) Prepare a short intake form (1 page) instead of an SOW; procurement tends to accept that faster.

I’ve approved a courtesy credit for this account to cover the extension — see attached credit note. If procurement needs formal paperwork after the trial, we can escalate. Please schedule an onboarding window for the week after the trial resumes.

Attachment: credit_note-2wk-extension.pdf (PDF, 12KB)

—Marissa Cole
